Enter a judgment on a property that cannot be computed

Source: R/csdg_check.R
csdg_judge.Rd

Records the analyst's judgment on a property of a claim that the package cannot compute, such as validity evidence for a construct named by the claim (G0b) or a coding error found in the data. Pass the result to csdg_check() (judgments). A judgment on G0b replaces the package's G0b entry; a judgment on any other gate is added as a further required property. Because the decision rule keeps the worst status per gate, a judgment can make a computed property open or contradicted but never offsets a computed contradiction.

Usage

csdg_judge(gate, status, note, property = NULL)

Arguments

gate

Gate identifier, for example "G0b".

status

supported(), contradicted(), or open_status().

note

The observation and its basis, for example "Reliability .86 and scalar invariance across waves (Table S4)".

property

Optional property text; defaults to the package's text for the gate.

Value

A CSDGJudgment list with gate, status, note, property, and date.

Examples

csdg_judge("G0b", supported(), note = "Reliability .86 and scalar invariance across the two waves.")
#> <CSDG judgment> G0b supported: Reliability .86 and scalar invariance across the two waves.
